name: The Voyage
closingLine: From the slipway to the edge of the world, every coast is drawn. Fair winds, captain.

provinces.name: The Shipyard
provinces.flavour: The ship is fitted out. Past the harbour mouth, the open water is calling.

provinces.name: The Open Sea
provinces.flavour: The storms are weathered. Off the bow, a shore of sand shimmers in the heat.

provinces.name: The Dunes
provinces.flavour: The sands are crossed. Past the last dune, the green closes in like a wall.

provinces.name: The Jungle
provinces.flavour: The lost city is found. North of the canopy, the rivers begin to freeze.

provinces.name: The Ice
provinces.flavour: The flag is planted. Past the pole, the map runs out.

provinces.name: The Edge
provinces.flavour: The dragons are charted. Past the last of them, the margin of the map lies blank no more.
